title: Composer: Environment Rollback Targets Exposed
summary: Cloud Composer environments now expose `imageVersionRollbackTargets` within `SoftwareConfig`, providing visibility into which image versions an environment can be rolled back to. These new fields are output-only; attempting to set them will now result in an error.
details: The `SoftwareConfig` schema has been updated to include a new `imageVersionRollbackTargets` array. This array contains `ImageVersionRollbackTarget` objects, each detailing an `imageVersion` and its `lastActiveTime` (the last time the environment ran that version). These properties (`imageVersion`, `lastActiveTime`, and the `imageVersionRollbackTargets` array itself) are explicitly marked as `readOnly` and are intended for informational purposes. This is a breaking change: if your client code previously attempted to send values for these fields in create or update requests (even if they were ignored before), those requests will now fail because these properties are immutable and output-only.
